entry: Have it proposed by the AI
title: A configuration proposed by the AI
intro: Say what your organisation does and how it handles its mail. The AI proposes a few attributes, the rules that decide them, and a few boards. You read what it proposes, and nothing changes until you apply it.
descriptionHint: What you do, who writes to you and about what, who answers what — and what tells one kind of email from another: senders, words, the mailbox it arrives in.
placeholder: We are an accounting firm of five. Clients write to us about their accounts; suppliers send their invoices to billing@…; anything from the tax office is urgent.
sent: The AI is sent this text, your answers, and your attributes and shared boards as they are. No email is sent, and nothing is kept of what you write here.
questionsIntro: Answer what you can: an answer left empty leaves the choice to the AI. It asks only once.
nothing: Nothing to change: what you have already does this.
sortKept: Apply the rules to the emails already kept too
sortKeptHint: So that the boards show them at once. Values set by hand stay as they are.
